purpose: Teach: 邦訳/自由民主党/自由党/角川書店/講じる/可用性/外為/用水

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、海外書籍の邦訳を社員に勧められたぞ
lines.en: When I was starting out, the staff recommended I read foreign books in translation.
lines.style: Quiet, almost ceremonial opening. Measured pace. Letting each phrase settle. The tone of someone sharing something they've thought about for decades—not boasting, just remembering aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは自由民主党の政策研究にも関心を持たれた
lines.en: Yes. Father was interested in Liberal Democratic Party policy research.
lines.style: Respectful, steady affirmation. Slightly formal register. Speaking about the past with care, as if handling something fragile. Even, attentive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、自由党時代の文献も大事にされたぞ
lines.en: Those documents from the Liberal Party era—he treasured those.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wistful nostalgia. Slower tempo. The softness of memory, not sadness. Letting the ending trail slightly, as if seeing something from long ago.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは角川書店と良好な関係を保たれた
lines.en: Yes. Father maintained a strong relationship with Kadokawa Publishing.
lines.style: Calm affirmation with quiet pride beneath. Even cadence. Speaking of a completed chapter with understated respect. Not dwelling, just confirming.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、危機に対策を講じる早さが見事だった
lines.en: The way he could anticipate a crisis and act so quickly—that was remarkable.
lines.style: Admiring, with the weight of genuine respect. Slight emphasis on the speed of response. Steady but warm. The voice of someone who watched this happen many times.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはシステムの可用性を経営の柱とされた
lines.en: Yes. Father made system reliability a cornerstone of the business.
lines.style: Measured, almost solemn. Speaking of a deliberate choice, a founding principle. Calm authority without performance. Honoring the decision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、外為で利益を上げる手腕もおありだった
lines.en: He had a real gift for foreign exchange trading too.
lines.style: Quiet admiration with a hint of awe. Slightly slower, letting the accomplishment land. Understated but genuine. The recognition of skill in a specific craft.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは工場の用水管理を厳格にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father was exacting about water management at the factory.
lines.style: Final affirmation, quieter and slightly softer than the others. Respectful closure. Speaking of something he inherited, a standard to maintain. Grounded and complete.
